source_snapshot.items: SOL console - in BIOS setup menu and output BIOS log , keyboard type check
source_snapshot.procedure: Conditionally run an unspecified IPMI OEM `Set SOL Enable`; open Operations > SOL console in BMC WebUI; power on SUT, enter BIOS setup, inspect console and keyboard; generic setup says clear logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: SOL shows boot log and BIOS setup screen, and keyboard input responds correctly.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO correctly refuses to substitute plain SSH for BIOS-stage SOL but provides no approved OEM enablement, serial/UART parameters, WebUI evidence, power authorization, safe key matrix or recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY adds target, safe BIOS input and cleanup controls. V3.1 refines this to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION because approved SOL transcript capture and bounded keys can be assisted while WebUI rendering, BIOS interpretation and power/BIOS boundaries remain human-controlled.

old_problem: The source names an OEM enable action but gives no command bytes, channel, payload instance, UART or BIOS-redirection parameters; guessing them could affect the wrong target. `Any key` is unsafe in BIOS, plain SSH/OS serial logs cannot prove BIOS-stage WebUI SOL, and the power-on plus exit/restore path is unspecified.
disposition_reason: Retain the exact BMC WebUI SOL and BIOS-stage coverage. Require vendor/Project-approved enable/readback/restore and serial parameters instead of guessing OEM bytes, one separately approved power-on/boot, attributable POST/setup markers and a harmless navigation-only key matrix with human visual confirmation. Project bindings and authorization are execution prerequisites, not further engineering decisions.
decision_basis: XLSX row 910, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, selection manifest, following OS-stage SOL case and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed.

SOL transport capture and bounded input may be assisted by an approved client, but the source explicitly covers the BMC WebUI path and BIOS menu rendering; host SSH or an alternate client alone cannot substitute.

ED-03 permits a standard management draft but prohibits guessed OEM parameters, ED-08 requires true visual evidence, ED-11 prohibits arbitrary BIOS changes and ED-20 keeps BIOS-stage SOL separate from OS-stage SOL.
The source power-on and BIOS interaction are state-changing/human-controlled boundaries. This review specifies them but does not execute them.

test_case.test_name: Verify BMC WebUI SOL BIOS POST/setup rendering and safe keyboard transport
test_case.purpose: Verify the intended BMC WebUI SOL session carries attributable BIOS POST/boot output, renders the BIOS setup menu and transports an approved harmless keyboard navigation matrix correctly for the verified SUT without saving BIOS changes or substituting OS/SSH evidence.
required_package: BMC/SUT asset, MAC/IP, BMC firmware/WebUI build, BIOS build and current host power state with independent observation/recovery path
Current SOL enable-state readback and exact vendor-approved enable/disable or WebUI method; no guessed OEM bytes
SOL channel/payload instance/privilege, UART baud/data/parity/stop/flow, terminal type/encoding and BIOS serial-redirection port map
Supported WebUI browser/client/account/role/session/audit configuration and any approved alternate capture client with stated coverage gap
Approved maintenance/power-on/boot window, BIOS-entry timing and target-specific POST/setup markers
Harmless keys such as arrows, Tab and Esc with expected focus/navigation, latency/drop/repeat/garble limits and prohibited save/reset/security/storage actions
Exit-without-save, SOL close, temporary-enable restore, final-state verification and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: HYBRID; DO NOT EXECUTE POWER OR BIOS ACTIONS WITHOUT POINT-OF-ACTION APPROVAL. Preserve SEL/BMC/SOL/boot/host logs and verify the BMC/SUT plus current state. If SOL is disabled, use only the exact approved enable/readback method and record original state; never guess OEM bytes/channel/UART parameters. A human opens Operations > SOL console in the WebUI and performs one approved host power-on/boot, capturing timestamped target-specific POST markers and BIOS setup rendering. On a preselected harmless menu, send only approved navigation keys and visually record exact response/latency/drop/repeat/garble. Stop at first anomaly, exit BIOS without saving, close SOL, restore only a temporary approved enable state and verify final host/BMC/BIOS state. An alternate client is corroborative unless explicitly approved as an override.
test_case.expected_result: The source WebUI SOL connects to the correct SUT, shows complete attributable BIOS-stage POST/boot markers and the BIOS setup menu, and every harmless key produces the expected single navigation/focus response within limits with no dropped/repeated/garbled input. BIOS configuration remains unchanged, the approved boot path completes or stops at its defined endpoint, SOL closes cleanly and any temporary enable state is restored. OS/SSH output alone does not pass.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved SOL/BIOS serial parameters and enablement, visual WebUI evidence of target-specific POST plus BIOS setup, complete safe-key results, one authorized boot, exit-without-save and verified final/restore state with engineer/human confirmation. Linux SSH, OS-stage serial output, passive boot logs, an alternate client without WebUI equivalence or arbitrary `any key` cannot pass. Wrong target, missing/garbled BIOS output, unsafe/incorrect/repeated/dropped key, unintended BIOS change, failed cleanup or unaccepted host state is FAIL. Missing OEM method, parameters, power approval, markers or recovery is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL, BMC audit, SOL, boot or host logs; preserve baseline and first failure.
Verify BMC/SUT and host power state before enabling SOL or presenting power-on; no reset, power-cycle or automatic retry substitute.
Do not guess OEM enable bytes, channel, payload, privilege, UART or terminal parameters; use only vendor/Project-approved values.
Do not save BIOS changes or alter boot order, firmware, security, passwords, storage or platform settings; use only the harmless navigation matrix.
Stop on wrong target, garbled stream, repeated/dropped key or uncertain BIOS state; exit without save, close SOL and restore only approved temporary state.
expected_evidence: BMC/SUT identity, BMC/BIOS/WebUI/client versions, host power baseline, SOL enable state/method and channel/UART/BIOS-redirection configuration
Power/boot and WebUI session approvals, redacted login/session/audit timestamps and independent host observation
Raw timestamped SOL capture with target-specific POST/boot markers plus screenshots proving WebUI BIOS setup rendering
Per-key matrix with transmitted harmless key, visible response/focus, latency and repeated/dropped/garbled result with human confirmation
Exit-without-save, session close, temporary-state restore and unchanged final BIOS/BMC/host evidence
Preserved logs, explicit alternate-client/WebUI coverage difference, no-retry proof and engineer-owned verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, garbled output, unexpected key behavior or uncertain BIOS state, cease input immediately, exit without saving if safely possible and close SOL. Verify host/BMC/BIOS state through the independent path, preserve first-failure evidence and restore only a documented temporary SOL state. Do not guess another OEM command, reboot or power-cycle automatically; escalate under the approved recovery SOP.
